FN-KLGT55A-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 296
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/19/2024
House Bill 296 as introduced could increase receipts to sheriffs by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of court-ordered restitution collected by the sheriff for costs incurred
for housing and care of persons convicted of organized retail theft.
